summary.headline: Sasken Q1 FY27 revenue rose 24% YoY to ₹339 Cr, with gross margin at 21.9% and Product Solutions margin down to 5.9%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 24% YoY and 1.6% QoQ to ₹339 Cr, led by Software Services at ₹219 Cr (+24.3% YoY). Software Services gross margin expanded 240 bps to 30.6%, while Product Solutions revenue of ₹120 Cr fell 3.9% QoQ and its margin dropped 310 bps QoQ to 5.9% on memory pricing, component costs and product mix. Q1 orders were US$47M TCV (US$34M new), with ACV of US$40M, and the company added five new logos. Operating cash flow has been negative for two years and management expects heavy cash consumption again in FY27.

financial_highlights.change: Sequential decline from Q4 one-offs in other income and lower FX gains

segments.name: Software Services
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹219 Cr (+24.3% YoY, +4.8% QoQ) with gross margin up 240 bps to 30.6% on utilization, cost discipline and scale. Management said both segments grew over 20% YoY.

segments.name: Product Solutions (incl. Borqs)
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹120 Cr (+23.6% YoY, -3.9% QoQ after strong Q4) with gross margin down 310 bps QoQ to 5.9%, attributed to memory availability, component pricing, program mix and silicon productization.

segments.name: Sasken Silicon
segments.commentary: Described as early-stage for Sasken; management said growth rates from last year will continue but gave no order split between production and other work. Q1 margin pressure partly tied to productization.

guidance_outlook: Management gave no numerical guidance; priority is disciplined, profitable growth and converting wins into revenue.

60x4x3 strategy: scale to US$4M run-rate revenue for at least 4 more accounts within about three years. Management said this is 'metaphoric' and may take one or two more years; the company is at quarter 9 of 12.
Margins expected to stabilise over FY27 as Q1 actions take effect; management will not give margin guidance but targets improvement through efficiency and value pricing.
Expects to add at least five to six sales heads in the rest of FY27.
Expects a large consumption of cash in FY27 from working capital and fixed assets; plans to fund growth from internal accruals plus external funds.
Borqs break-even at about US$12M quarterly revenue.
capex_capacity: Inaugurated Sasken Silicon Incubation Center in Hubballi for university collaboration and semiconductor talent.
Opened a new centre of excellence in Hyderabad.
Q1 inventory build to manage memory shortage contributed to negative operating cash flow.
demand_pricing: Q1 TCV US$47M (US$34M new deal wins); ACV US$40M (US$24M from new wins). Management said TCV is total order booking for the quarter, not backlog, and that the backlog gives about 9-10 months' carry.
Active customers 93 vs 79 a year earlier; five new logos added. Top-five customer share about 56%, broadly stable.
Revenue mix: North America 30%, EMEA about 25%, India 26%, APAC about 20%.

Two new hyperscaler engagements, one for next-gen devices and one for OS sustenance, from different hyperscalers. One multi-year deal with a global technology company covers agentic AI, LLM validation and intelligent testing.
Management said product pricing pass-through to customers does not carry the same incremental margin when memory costs rise.

qa_highlights.question: What is the pipeline to cross US$4M run-rate accounts in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 60x4x3 target is metaphoric, may take one or two more years, and named no accounts. It is adding sales bandwidth and focusing on mining the other active customers.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Product Solutions margin fall to 5.9%?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said memory pricing is passed on to customers but without the usual incremental margin, and silicon productization changed product mix. He expects margins to stabilise over the year and asked investors to look at full-year figures.

qa_highlights.question: Is headcount growth linked to acquisitions?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said headcount was about 2,200 at end-Q1 FY26 including roughly 300 from Borqs, and the rise to 2,658 is organic. He added that AI is now part of delivery, so headcount may stop being the main growth metric.

qa_highlights.question: Why has operating cash flow been negative for two years?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the cause is investment in working capital and fixed assets for scaling, not collection problems. Q1 also included inventory build for memory shortages, and management expects large cash consumption again in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Does Borqs still break even at US$60-70M top line?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said break-even is about US$12M quarterly revenue, with profit contribution rising above that.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a Sasken Silicon automotive instrument cluster win?
qa_highlights.answer: Hareesh said the module is ready but Chinese module suppliers remain cost-sensitive, so no commercial order yet; opportunities may come in NAD and other modules.

risks_watch: Product Solutions gross margin of 5.9% and memory/component cost pass-through; watch whether it stabilises in Q2-Q3.
Negative operating cash flow for two years, with large FY27 consumption expected; watch external funding and working capital.
Revenue concentration: top five customers about 56% of revenue.
Conversion of TCV (US$47M) into revenue; the 60x4x3 US$4M-account target timeline has been extended.
Software Services margin expansion must hold as hiring adds lateral and fresher staff.
Sasken Silicon progress depends on unannounced partnerships (GlobalFoundries, Intel, TSMC); no announcements yet.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and customer momentum, but cautious and non-committal on margins, cash flow and timelines. Management declined to give numerical guidance, and several answers on the 60x4x3 target, silicon partnerships and orders were non-specific.
key_quotes: We are very careful on making sure, and I think Ranjan has emphasized that going forward, we are making sure that improvement will be there in execution and operational excellence.
So all of that growth is actually organic addition to headcount.
All those three are in progress, and we have made substantial, significant progress towards strengthening those partnerships

growth.why: No numerical revenue guidance; management gives no margin guidance. Q1 revenue grew 24% YoY, backed by US$47M TCV (US$34M new wins) and ~9-10 months backlog carry, but no specific capacity additions were described.
